title: See You Again
label: ch:zh-zaijian
canDo: I can write 再 and 见, say goodbye with 再见, read the word literally as "see again" because its two pieces genuinely add up, and name which expressions I know are spoken differently from how they are written.

payoff.summary: The first exchange in the track that opens, turns and closes -- greeting, an answer either way, and a parting -- with every line built from characters the reader has written rather than a phrase memorised whole.
